newsitem.title: CHINA: Dresdner Bank to open Beijing branch.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner Bank to open Beijing branch.

text.p: Germany's Dresdner Bank AG will open its Beijing branch in July and expects business in China to grow 20 percent this year, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
Dresdner's Beijing branch would formally open on July 4, the newspaper said, quoting bank officials.
It would be the bank's third branch in China. It has branches in Shanghai and the southern boomtown of Shenzhen near Hong Kong, and a representative office in southern Guangzhou.
Michael Volz-Kjer, general manager of the bank's China operations, forecast that business volume would grow 20 percent this year, the newspaper said.
The business volume of the bank's China operations jumped 40 percent to three billion marks last year from 1995.
Dresdner had applied to conduct local currency business and hoped to be more involved in China's securities market, he said.
Last month, another German bank, Bayerische Landesbank, opened a representative office in Beijing, its second in China.
